To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

laser diode noise characteristics (electrooptical noise and correlation between optical and electrical fluctuations) are very important for laser diode quality evaluation and reliability prediction; laser diode operation at the threshold region and below the threshold is the most critical for laser diode operation and reliability.
the noise characteristics of InGaAs/InP laser diodes are related with the leakage current, additional generation-recombination noise processes and the mode hopping effect.

laser diode noise characteristics are the most sensitive indicators of LD quality and reliability; laser diode noise measurements are very useful for LD quality assessment and for the optimization of laser diode design and fabrication; LD facet coating suppresses the mode-hopping effect that is characteristic for FP LD operation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the noise characteristic investigations of different quality InP-based laser diode structures.
the noise characteristics of InGaAs/InP DFP and FP laser diodes and the relationship of the noise to the laser diode degradation.
the noise characteristic investigation of InGaAs/InP laser diodes with the aim to find out the reasons of laser diode degradation and to improve laser diode quality.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the noise measurements are very useful for the laser diode quality control.
the laser diode reliability and lifetime is strongly related to its noise characteristics.
the laser diode quality depends on a number of technological and structural features and that there are a number of noise characteristics features that can indicate laser diode reliability problems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
laser diode quality can be significantly improved by the proper laser structure and fabrication process optimization.
laser diode noise investigations are the powerful tool that can be applied to clear up laser diode operation problems and can be used for laser quality and reliability assessment.
laser diodes with high quality epitaxial layer structure (without defects) are characterized by high quality operation characteristics and high lifetime.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the noise characteristics are a very powerful tool for the laser diode quality assessment.
laser diode noise characteristic investigation is a powerful tool to estimate laser quality and reliability and to find the ways of laser diode improvement.
laser diode design and fabrication features should be chosen with the aim to reduce the generation-recombination processes that are the main reason for LD noise and reliability problems.
